checks.name: Only opaque six-digit sRGB is accepted and canonicalized
Authored guide has bounded independent records and narrowed fields
Bad identities duplicate tokens and unbounded records are rejected
Motion and symbol values cannot introduce arbitrary styles
Luminance black white and primary weights follow the W3C equation
Both sides of the current .04045 sRGB branch are covered
Extremes identity and pair symmetry retain raw values
Normal text threshold uses raw values on either side of 4.5
Large text ratio is distinct from eligibility and other conformance
Display never rounds a failing threshold up
Static CSS and JSON exports match the executable model
Symbol rotations preserve unique original identities and user count
Contrast report contains the actual pair raw ratio version and scope

limitations: Numeric model fixtures are not full WCAG conformance or source-site reconstruction
